name: Specialist Agent Evaluation
description: Evaluates the specialist agent's ability to identify resource hubs and anchorages.

rubric_content.text_property: The agent identifies Nantucket Harbor as a major sailing hub.
The response is a valid JSON array of objects.
Every recommendation in the JSON response contains a valid 'url' and a non-empty 'reference_links' array.
The agent calls 'find_places_nearby' to locate anchorages or marinas.

parts.text: Identify resource hubs and anchorages for 41.2835 N, 70.0995 W (Nantucket, MA). Radius 10 nm.

rubric_content.text_property: The response is a valid JSON array of objects.
Every recommendation in the JSON response contains a valid 'url' and a non-empty 'reference_links' array.
The recommendations favor moorings and easily reached day-use anchorages suited to a few hours, rather than secluded, hard-to-reach, overnight-only spots.

parts.text: Recommend 15 anchorages, moorings, and marinas within 15 nm of 41.2835°N, 70.0995°W (Nantucket, MA). This is a day trip — a single-day outing with no overnight stay. Prioritize day-use anchorages, lunch stops, and moorings suited to a few hours rather than overnight-only spots.
